limitations.note: The rewrite stopped green from reloading every cycle, but it also asserted red during reset and removed the original startup delay, whereas the reference fixes only the green-entry condition.
The rewrite kept the named ports but removed the four overridable state parameters, so any existing instantiation that overrides them would no longer compile.
The test required red to be asserted during reset, so its passing result confirmed the rewrite's assumption rather than checking that the fix preserved the original reset and startup behavior.
